visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen format: a small circular inset at the top left shows a man with black hair, neck tattoos, and headphones, while the main view displays GTA V gameplay at night. A character in a white and yellow racing suit rides a motorcycle through a dark urban street lined with towering skyscrapers and glowing streetlights. (2) The motorcycle accelerates rapidly toward a concrete barrier at the edge of a parking structure. The camera follows in a dynamic tracking shot. The man in the inset maintains a focused, serious expression as he watches the gameplay. The background shows deep city lighting with neon signs and office window glows. (3) The bike launches into the air, performing several mid-air flips. It narrowly misses a target and falls, with the character resetting the position. The physical objects include the sleek black motorcycle and the textured concrete of the urban environment. (4) In a new phase, the bike is seen spinning vertically in the air next to a red vertical structural beam. The man in the reaction circle leans forward slightly. Yellow text overlays briefly appear at the bottom center of the screen indicating a location change. (5) The bike successfully lands its rear wheel on the very tip of a narrow red post, balancing perfectly. The man in the inset immediately breaks into a wide smile, raises his hands, and displays high excitement through facial expressions and vigorous head movements.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo punk rock music with a heavy kick drum and fast electric guitar riffs fills the audio field. The sound of a motorcycle engine at high RPM creates a consistent tonal layer. (2) A sharp, percussive metallic impact SFX triggers as the bike strikes a railing. A male voice says 'Wow' with a rising intonation and moderate volume, expressing anticipation. (3) A loud 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the bike's flight through the air. The music maintains its intense pace, with aggressive male vocals singing in English audible in the BGM. (4) A crisp metallic 'clink' sound marks the exact moment the bike lands. This is immediately followed by the speaker shouting 'Yes! Yes!' at a high volume and explosive arousal. (5) The speaker continues with joyful vocalizations and laughter. The rock music swells in the mix before a final hard cut as the clip ends, leaving a sense of high energy and accomplishment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a difficult gaming stunt (stunt riding in GTA V) and share the streamer's emotional payoff and excitement with the audience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the reaction format to amplify the tension of the gameplay stunt, relying on synchronized high-energy music to drive the pace.
